text:
ana: Quick rollout digest — v2 compatibility status and owner asks.

ana: TL;DR: canary window 2026-03-29 to 2026-04-02. If no major regressions, target full deprecation of the v1 shim 2026-04-15.

ana: Owners we need confirmation: platform=ana, eng-infra=yusuf, eng-runtime=sam, sdk=monica, ml=li. Add yourself to MIGRATE-120 board if you haven't.

monica: I have SDK#342 almost ready; added compat shim + tests. @sam can you review? :eyes: 

sam: ack. I'll prioritize the review, but FYI runtime perf on long sequences regressed in canary yesterday. Lowering canary QPS to 30% until I find root cause.

yusuf: INFRA-821 (gateway header routing) is queued. Need about 72h to roll the edge change and smoke the canary. Scheduling now; ETA Fri EOD.

li: ML fallback (ML-197) implemented; still need to run the prompt set harness for regressions. Will run overnight and post results here.

ana: Can we make the deprecation a toggle so we can flip back if customers hit issues? e.g. `/rollout toggle v1-shim --off` or env flag `DEPRECATE_V1=false` during canary.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary-2 smoke tests: passed ✅ (2026-03-18 02:14 UTC)

monica: @sam pushed SDK#342 as draft PR: https://internal/pulls/342 — added migration notes in README and a compatibility test. Requesting review from @sam and @devex.

sam: Reviewing now. If the runtime fix requires a kernel fallback we might need a small patch in the runtime repo; will open PR if needed.

yusuf: Heads up — the edge change touches rate-limiter config; @platform please confirm no customers on dedicated with custom RL rules.

ana: Platform confirmed — no dedicated customers affected. We'll still email the top 10 active integrations about the canary window.

monica: docs update ready, will send draft to marketing for the notification mail.

li: prompt harness run looks clean so far, a few cases flagged for review (small score diff). Posting detailed csv in the migration board.

ana: Action items: 1) @sam review SDK#342 (EOD). 2) @yusuf finish INFRA-821 roll (72h). 3) @li post prompt harness results to MIGRATE-120. 4) @monica coordinate docs + send draft. 5) I'll schedule the customer mail and add a rollback playbook.

ana: anything else? If no objections I'll lock the canary QPS change tonight and reconvene Mon for the go/no-go.

monica: :thumbsup:

sam: :+1: will update with runtime findings.

yusuf: :shipit:

ana: closing thread for today — will post final go/no-go in this thread Monday morning. Thanks all.
